sql:
SELECT fish_date_t, fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, cls, boat, landing, anglers, yt
FROM trips
ORDER BY fish_date_t DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT cls, COUNT(*) n, AVG(yt) avg_yt, AVG(yt*1.0/NULLIF(anglers,0)) avg_yt_per_angler, MAX(fish_date_t) max_t
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t > 730.875 - 14
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY avg_yt_per_angler DESC
SELECT index_id, value, avail_t FROM climate ORDER BY avail_t DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT fish_date_doy/30 as month_bin, cls, SUM(yt) sum_yt, SUM(anglers) sum_ang, COUNT(*) n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t > 730.875 - 400
GROUP BY month_bin, cls
HAVING sum_yt > 0
ORDER BY month_bin

SELECT fish_date_doy, SUM(yt) sum_yt, SUM(anglers) sum_ang
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t BETWEEN 365 AND 730
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

summary: Replace no-op strategy with a reactive one: pre-commit PTO 14 days out only when historical day-of-year yellowtail rate is meaningful, and book offers whenever their class shows nonzero fleet-wide catches in the last 3 days.
